# lila code (lichess.org)

The files under `ui/` in this folder were copied unmodified from the [lila](https://github.com/lichess-org/lila) project, the lichess.org server, at commit `e22c4ee36587b89a8c61107acb4e4a01a8c2ee61`.

Copyright (c) 2012-2026 the lila authors (see https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/graphs/contributors). Distributed under the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3 or later, the same license as ligungi (see [LICENSE](../../../../LICENSE) and lila's [COPYING.md](https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/blob/master/COPYING.md)).

ligungi is not affiliated with lichess.org. We do not use the lichess name, logo or favicon, which lila reserves to refer to lichess.org.

Files generated by us (not part of lila):

- `ui/lib/css/theme/gen/_wrap.scss`: generated by `apps/web/scripts/lila-wrap.mjs`, equivalent to lila's build step.

To update: copy the `ui/<module>/css` folders again from a newer lila commit and run `npm run lila:wrap -w @ligungi/web`.
